mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is termed as a sample survey."
The method is termed as a sample survey.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference between the lower class limit of any interval and the lower class limit of the next class interval."
Class width is the difference between the lower class limit of any interval and the lower class limit of the next class interval.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a construct invented by man to account for presumably motivated behaviour. iv."
Motivation is a construct invented by man to account for presumably motivated behaviour. iv.

Report writing is a process of analysing, understanding, appreciating and consolidating the findings and project a meaningful and coherent view of the phenomenon studied.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first step in data collection."
Secondary data collection is the first step in data collection.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those variables whose values can be determined by counting."
The discrete variables are those variables whose values can be determined by counting.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to both the breadth of the problem and the depth of analysis. iv."
Coverage refers to both the breadth of the problem and the depth of analysis. iv.

Questionnaire design is one of the major tools in social survey.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the average deviation of a distribution of scores from the mean."
The mean deviation is the average deviation of a distribution of scores from the mean.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of determining systematically and objectively the relevance, efficiency, effectiveness and impact of the activity in the light of the objectives."
Evaluation is the process of determining systematically and objectively the relevance, efficiency, effectiveness and impact of the activity in the light of the objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indication of the odds against the results of the study occurring by chance."
The probability value (p-value) is an indication of the odds against the results of the study occurring by chance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means of testing the null hypothesis."
The standard error is a means of testing the null hypothesis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to test this type of hypothesis."
Inferential statistics are used to test this type of hypothesis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as a selected number from a population to represent it."
Sample A sample may be defined as a selected number from a population to represent it.

Statistics is concerned with data collection, organisation, analyses and interpretation of data collected for decision making.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the midpoint of a distribution."
The median is the midpoint of a distribution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the squared deviation around the mean."
The variance is the squared deviation around the mean.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the orderly procedure by which man increases his knowledge."
Research is the orderly procedure by which man increases his knowledge.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described in terms of the tails of the distribution."
Skew is described in terms of the tails of the distribution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of change from the existing level to a planned new level."
Development is a process of change from the existing level to a planned new level.
